title: Whale and well lessons
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y2 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: whale and well lessons)
intro: Lesson 14: Prophets Yunus and Yusuf (عليهما السلام): hope and forgiveness. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Yunus in the whale
points: Yunus left his people without waiting
He was swallowed by a whale
In the dark he made du'a; Allah saved him

panels.title: Yusuf forgives
points: His brothers threw him in a well
Years later he became a leader in Egypt
He forgave them: 'No blame on you today'

blocks.title: Sort into: Yunus: hope / Yusuf: forgiveness
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Yunus: hope, Yusuf: forgiveness.
blocks.answer: Yunus: hope: The whale; Du'a in the dark. Yusuf: forgiveness: The well; 'No blame on you today'

blocks.text: Draw a whale and a well (no people). Write one lesson under each.

keywords.def: letting go of being upset with someone

questions.q: Tell Yunus's story in three steps.
questions.a: He left, was swallowed by the whale, made du'a and was saved.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, draw a whale and a well (no people). Write one lesson under each.
questions.a: Whale: never lose hope; well: forgive others.

questions.q: Extend: say the start of Yunus's du'a: 'La ilaha illa anta ...'
questions.a: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka (There is no god but You, glory be to You)

questions.q: Stretch: when could you say Yunus's du'a?
questions.a: When something is hard or I have done wrong

questions.q: What did Yunus do inside the whale?
questions.a: A) Made du'a to Allah. He made du'a and kept hope; Allah saved him.

questions.q: Think again: how does forgiving feel?
questions.a: Light and good; Allah loves those who forgive.
